mutants.description: Reverse the public clamp direction. The below-bottom input corner must reach the bed plane and its incident triangle normal must be refreshed; the reversed predicate leaves that corner below the plane.

Bypass rejection of zero-area snapped triangles. The symmetric triangle fixture is nondegenerate before the move and collapses exactly onto a line at the bed plane, so the no-snap/zero-dirty-result oracle fails.
mutants.new: if (false) { ok = false; break; }  // would collapse to zero area
mutants.old: if (n2 < 1e-20) { ok = false; break; }  // would collapse to zero area

mutants.description: Remove the maximum-fold-angle guard while keeping the opposite-winding guard. The skinny positive-orientation face remains nonzero-area after flattening but rotates by about 88.9 degrees, so its position must remain unchanged.
mutants.old: if (dot < 0.0 || dot * dot < fold_cos * fold_cos * o2 * n2)
